Rashi on Eruvin 95a:12:1.hebrew: נפרצה לכרמלית - שרי כר' יהודה, דאי נמי אתי לאפוקי לבר, לאו איסורא דאורייתא איכא:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:12:1.english: [Where it] was breached into a karmelit - [Shmuel] permits [it] in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda, for even if one comes to carry out outside, there is no Torah prohibition.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:13:1.hebrew: על גבי שני בתים - והם בשני צידי רה"ר — מטלטלין תחת העלייה, דפי תקרה מכאן ומכאן יורד וסותם:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:13:1.english: Atop two houses - And they are on both sides of the public domain — [one] may carry beneath the upper story, for the edge of the ceiling from this [side] and from that [side] descends and closes [it off].

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:13:2.english: And likewise bridges with a thoroughfare - That have partitions from below on both sides.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:14:1.english: One may establish an eiruv for an open alleyway - Since there are two partitions.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:15:1.hebrew: דאורייתא - הלכה למשה מסיני, כדאמרינן בפ"ק (דף ד.): "שיעורין, חציצין ומחיצות — הלכה למשה מסיני". והרי יש כאן ב' מחיצות משני הבתים, דאי לאו משום פי תקרה, לא הוה שרי:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:15:1.english: By Torah law - [That is, a] halakhah to Moses from Sinai, as we say in the first chapter (4a): "Measurements, interpositions, and partitions are a halakhah to Moses from Sinai." And behold, there are two partitions here from the two houses; for were it not for [the principle that] the edge of the roof [descends and seals], it would not be permitted.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:16:1.hebrew: יתר על כן וכו' - רישא דברייתא: אחד חלון שבין שני בתים, ואחד חלון שבין שתי חצירות, וגשרים, ונפשות, ורה"ר המקורה — מטלטלין תחתיהן בשבת, דברי ר' יהודה. יתר על כן אמר רבי יהודה — דאפילו רה"ר גמורה, ואין שם תקרה למימר יורד וסותם, שרי בשתי מחיצות של שני צידי רה"ר:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:16:1.english: Furthermore, etc. - The beginning of the baraita [states]: Whether a window between two houses or a window between two courtyards, bridges, sepulchral monuments, and a covered public domain — one may carry beneath them on Shabbat; [these are] the words of Rabbi Yehuda. "Furthermore, Rabbi Yehuda said" — that even in an actual public domain, where there is no ceiling to say [that its edge] descends and seals, it is permitted with [only] two partitions of the two sides of the public domain.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:17:1.hebrew: מההיא אין - מצית למשמע דשתי מחיצות דאורייתא, אבל ממתני' לא שמעינן לה, דטעמא משום סתימת פי תקרה הוא:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:17:1.english: From that [baraita], yes - You can deduce that two partitions [constitute a domain by] Torah law; but from our Mishnah we cannot deduce it, as the reason [there] is due to the closing [effect of] the edge of the ceiling.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:18:1.english: [The mishna] is also precise - That Rabbi Yehuda maintains that two partitions [suffice] by Torah law.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:19:1.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא - טעמיה דר' יהודה דקמייתא משום דשתי מחיצות דאוריי' — היינו דקתני "ועוד זו", דמשמע: ועוד זו, אע"ג דליכא פי תקרה, מתיר ר' יהודה משום האי טעמא. אלא אי אמרת טעמיה בקמייתא משום פי תקרה — מאי "ועוד"? הא במבוי ליכא פי תקרה! לשון אחר: מתני' נמי דייקא כרבה, דטעמא דקמייתא משום פי תקרה הוא. וה"ג: "אא"ב דטעמא דר"י בקמייתא משום דקסבר פי תקרה יורד וסותם, ובתרייתא משום שתי מחיצות — היינו דקתני 'ועוד זו מתיר רבי יהודה', ואע"ג דליכא פי תקרה, משום שתי מחיצות. אלא אי אמרת קמייתא נמי משום שתי מחיצות — מאי 'ועוד'? היא היא, ופשיטא דמערבין!" ראשון שמעתי, ואית דגרסי כלישנא בתרא, ומסתברא כוותייהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:19:1.english: Granted, if you say - [Granted, if you say that] Rabbi Yehuda’s rationale in the first [ruling] is because two partitions [suffice] by Torah law — that is why [the mishna] teaches "And furthermore this," which implies: and furthermore, this [case too], even though there is no edge of a roof, Rabbi Yehuda permits because of this [same] rationale. But if you say his rationale in the first [ruling] is because of the edge of a roof, what is "And furthermore"? Behold, in an alleyway there is no edge of a roof! Another explanation: The mishna is also precise in accordance with Rabba, that the rationale in the first [ruling] is because of the edge of a roof. And this is the text: "Granted, if you say that Rabbi Yehuda’s rationale in the first [ruling] is because he maintains the edge of a roof descends and seals, and in the latter [ruling] is because of two partitions — that is why [the mishna] teaches: 'And furthermore, this [case] Rabbi Yehuda permits,' [meaning] even though there is no edge of a roof, [he permits it] because of two partitions. But if you say the first [ruling] is also because of two partitions — what is 'And furthermore'? It is the very same [case], and it is obvious that they may establish an eiruv!" The first [version] I heard [from my teachers], but there are those who read according to the latter version, and it appears logical in accordance with them.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:1:1.hebrew: קורה ארבעה מתיר בחורבה - חורבה הפרוצה ברשות הרבים ונאסרה בטלטול, ויש בה קורה — ראשיה נתונים על שני יתידות — מותר לטלטל תחתיה, דארבע פיותיה יורדין וסותמין: ב' בצדה, וב' בראשיה:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:1:1.english: A beam four [handbreadths wide] permits [carrying] in a ruin - A ruin that is breached into the public domain and [consequently] became forbidden for carrying, and there is a beam in it — its ends placed upon two pegs — it is permitted to carry beneath it, for its four edges descend and seal [it]: two at its sides and two at its ends.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:1.english: One who finds phylacteries - In a field, in a place where they [would be] lost.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:2.english: Brings them in - Into the city and into the house.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:3.hebrew: זוג זוג - אחד בראש ואחד בזרוע, והיינו זוג, כדרך שלובשן בחול; וחוזר תמיד ומכניסן זוג אחר זוג עד שיכלו:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:3.english: Pair by pair - One on the head and one on the arm, and that is a pair, in the manner that he wears them on a weekday; and he continually returns and brings them in, pair after pair, until they are finished.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:4.hebrew: שנים שנים - זוג בראש וזוג בזרוע, ובגמרא בעי טעמא מאי נינהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:4.english: Two [pairs by] two [pairs] - A pair on the head and a pair on the arm; and in the Gemara, it asks what the reason for them is.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:5.hebrew: בישנות - שניכר הקשר העשוי כמין שדי, דודאי תפילין הן ויש בהן קדושה, ואסור להניחן בבזיון:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:5.english: [With regard to] old [ones] - Where the knot formed in the shape of [the Name] Shaddai is evident, for they are certainly phylacteries and have sanctity, and it is forbidden to leave them in disgrace.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:6.hebrew: אבל בחדשות פטור - מלהכניסן. דילמא קמיע הן בעלמא, ואין בהן קדושה אלא בנעשים כהלכתן — והיינו לשמן. הלכך, לא מחללינן שבתא עלייהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:22:6.english: However, with regard to new [ones], he is exempt - From bringing them in. Perhaps they are merely an amulet, and they possess no sanctity unless they are made according to their halakhah, that is, for their sake [with specific intent]. Therefore, we do not desecrate Shabbat for them.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:23:1.hebrew: צבתים - קשרים קשרים, הרבה תפילין בכל קשר. ובגמ' מפרש מאי צבתים ומאי כריכות:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:23:1.english: Bundles - Tied bundles, [with] many tefillin in each knot. And in the Gemara it explains what [is meant by] tzevatim and what [is meant by] kerikhot.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:23:2.hebrew: מחשיך עליהן - ימתין עד שתחשך, וישב שם וישמרם, ולכשתחשך יטלם יחד. ובגמ' פריך: וליעיילינהו זוג זוג:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:23:2.english: He waits with them until dark - He shall wait until it gets dark, and sit there and guard them; and when it gets dark, he may take them together. And in the Gemara, it asks: But let him bring them in pair by pair!

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:3:1.hebrew: שיש לה פצימין - עמודין קבועין במחיצותיה, פחות מג':
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:3:1.english: That has posts - Pillars fixed in its walls, [spaced] less than three [handbreadths apart].

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:1.hebrew: אליבא דשמואל כ"ע לא פליגי - כלומר, ודאי כדקאמרת: אביי כרב ולא כשמואל, דמודה אביי דלשמואל פסולה; דכיון דבאכסדרה, דהנך פיות תקרה לאכסדרה נעשו, ואפ"ה אסר בטלטול שבת — כ"ש דלא מהני לענין סוכה, דלא לסוכה עבידי:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:1.english: According to Shmuel, everyone agrees - That is to say, certainly, as you said: Abaye [holds] in accordance with Rav and not in accordance with Shmuel, for Abaye concedes that according to Shmuel [the sukka] is invalid; for since regarding a portico, where those edges of the roof were made for the portico, even so [Shmuel] forbade carrying on Shabbat — all the more so does it not avail regarding a sukka, where they were not made for a sukka.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:2.hebrew: כי פליגי אליבא דרב - כלומר, הא דאמר "רבא כשמואל ולא כרב" — לא היא, דרבא נמי כרב אמרה למילתיה, ואמר לך: ע"כ לא קא שרי רב לענין שבת:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:2.english: Where they disagree [is] according to Rav - That is to say, that which [the Gemara suggested], that "Rava [holds] in accordance with Shmuel and not in accordance with Rav" — it is not [so], for Rava also stated his position in accordance with Rav, and he [could] say to you: Rav permitted [it] only regarding Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:3.hebrew: אלא דהני מחיצות - פי', אותן הקורות הנתונים על ארבעה עמודים — דאינהו פי תקרה — לאכסדרה עבידי:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:3.english: Only that these partitions - Meaning, those beams placed on four pillars — which are the edge of the ceiling — were made for the portico.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:4.hebrew: לאו לסוכה - לשם סוכה. אע"ג דלא בעי מחיצות לשמן, כולי האי מיהא לא מקילינן:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:5:4.english: Not for the sukka - [That is, not made] for the sake of the sukka. Even though we do not require partitions [to be made] for their sake, nevertheless, we are not lenient to that extent.

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:9:1.hebrew: במה דברים אמורים - דצריך להודיע, בפרק חלון:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:9:1.english: In what case are these matters stated - [Regarding the requirement] that one must inform [him], in the chapter [entitled] Chelon:

Rashi on Eruvin 95a:9:2.hebrew: ערובי חצירות - לעולם הוא זכות להן, אבל עירובי תחומין — פעמים שהוא חוב, שמפסידין לרוח שכנגדה:
Rashi on Eruvin 95a:9:2.english: A joining of courtyards - It is always a benefit to them; but a joining of [Shabbat] boundaries — at times it is a disadvantage, as they cause [him] to lose in the opposite direction.

Tosafot on Eruvin 95a:22:1.hebrew: המוצא תפילין - הך פירקא במסכת שבת ה"ל למיתני גבי הוצאות; אלא משום דקתני סיפא: "רבי יהודה אומר: נותן אדם לחבירו וחבירו לחבירו, ואפילו חוץ לתחום", ועוד משום דקתני בסוף פרקין: "רבי שמעון אומר: כל מקום שהתירו לך חכמים, משלך נתנו לך", ומפרש בגמ' דקאי אסוף "מי שהוציאוהו":
Tosafot on Eruvin 95a:22:1.english: One who finds phylacteries - This chapter should have been taught in Tractate Shabbat alongside [the laws of] carrying; rather, [it is taught here] because the latter clause teaches: "Rabbi Yehuda says: A person hands [them] to his fellow, and his fellow to his fellow, and even outside the [Shabbat] boundary." And furthermore, because it teaches at the end of our chapter: "Rabbi Shimon says: Anywhere that the Sages permitted to you, from your own they gave to you," and [the Gemara] explains in the Gemara that it refers back to the end of [the chapter] Mi Shehotzi'uhu.

Tosafot on Eruvin 95a:22:2.hebrew: מכניסן זוג זוג - בספ"ק דביצה (דף טו.) מוכח דאיירי דלא מינטרי מחמת כלבי; אבל מינטרי מחמת כלבי, אע"ג דלא מינטרי מחמת גנבי — לא:
Tosafot on Eruvin 95a:22:2.english: "He brings them in pair by pair" - At the end of the first chapter of Beitzah (15a), it is proved that [the Mishnah] is dealing with [a case] where they are not safeguarded from dogs; but [if] they are safeguarded from dogs, even though they are not safeguarded from thieves, no [he may not bring them in].

Tosafot on Eruvin 95a:22:3.hebrew: אבל בחדשות פטור - איסור נמי איכא, דלקמן (עירובין צז.) תניא: אוסר בחדשות:
Tosafot on Eruvin 95a:22:3.english: "However, with regard to new ones, he is exempt" - There is also a prohibition, as later (Eruvin 97a) it is taught: "[He] prohibits in [the case of] new ones."
